sentences.text:
Author: Surepalli Nanda
Bench: Surepalli Nanda
 Hon'Ble Mrs Justice Surepalli Nanda
 Writ Petition No.17140 Of 2023
Order:

Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned Government Pleader for Municipal Administration and Urban Development appearing for respondent No.1, learned standing counsel for GHMC appearing for respondent No.2, learned Assistant Government Pleader for Land Acquisition appearing for respondent Nos.3 and 4 and learned counsel appearing for respondent Nos.5 and 6.
2.

The petitioner approached the Court seeking the prayer as follows:
"To issue an appropriate Writ Order or Direction more particularly one in the nature of Writ of Mandamus declaring the action of the respondents in proposing to issue the Award and pay the compensation amount to the 5th respondent and 6th respondent herein and other legal heirs of Late.Mohd.Basheeruddin Ghori basing on the false and fabricated documents in lieu of the acquisition of the house property bearing H.No.3-31 corresponding to new H.No.8-3-33 situated at Old Bowenpally Opp. to Masjid-e-Hussaini Balanagar Mandal WP_17140_2023 SN,J within Kukatpally Municipality R.R.District, inspite of the representation dt 16/6/2023 as being illegal arbitrary unjust and unconstitutional and consequently direct the respondent authorities to conduct enquiry pursuant to the representation dt 16/6/2023 and to issue the notice under Section 15 (1) of the Act read with Rule 21 duly mentioning the names of the petitioner and other legal heirs of Late.Mohd.Mohiuddin Ghori as well as other legal heirs of Late.Mohammed Ahmed Ghori and enable the petitioner to lodge the objections and to grant such other relief or reliefs as this Hon'ble Court deems fit and proper in the circumstances of the case."

3. Learned Assistant Government Pleader for Land Acquisition brings on record written instructions filed by respondent No.3 and in particular relevant portion of the said written instructions reads as under:
"The land acquisition proceedings are at initial stage.

At this stage Smt Naseeminnissa Begum filed Writ Petition No.10355 of 2023 claiming to be one of the Mohammed Ruknuddin Ghouri vs The State Of Telangana on 10 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/57411447/
1 share/stake holder in premises No.8-3-33, old Bowenpally, Balanagar Mandal,
Medchal-Malkajgiri District.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The Hon'ble Court dismissed the Writ petition as premature on 17.04.2023, observing as follows:
"As the acquisition proceedings are at preliminary stage, the present Writ Petition is premature and as such this Court is not inclined to entertain this Writ Petition at this stage.
In case, if any notice is issued WP_17140_2023 SN,J proposing to acquire the subject property, it is open for the petitioner to make a claim and assert her rights.
In case, if the petitioner makes any claim before the respondents, the respondent-Land Acquisition Officer shall consider the same and pass appropriate orders thereon, in accordance law..."
The notice U/s 15 of the Act of 2013 has been issued on 30.05.2023 fixing the date of hearing on 31.07.2023 at 3:00 pm to all the known interested persons.

However, the writ petitioner herein is being treated as one of the interested persons and is being addressed to file objection, claim/succession to the property on or before and also to attend the hearing on 31.07.2023 at 3:00 pm.
The writ petitioner may be advised to approach this respondent with his claim and the writ petition may be closed as premature."

4. Taking into consideration the written instructions filed by the respondent No.3-Special Deputy Collector, LA, GHMC, Hyderabad, the petitioner is directed to file objection, claim/succession of the subject property before the respondent-Land Acquisition Officer and also to attend the hearing on 31.07.2023 at 03:00 p.m. WP_17140_2023 SN,J 5.

entities.text: Special Deputy Collector, LA, GHMC, Hyderabad
entities.label: RESPONDENT

sentences.text: Accordingly, the Writ Petition is disposed of directing the petitioner to approach the respondent-Land Acquisition Officer with his claim petition.
However, there shall be no order as to costs.
Miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending in this Writ Petition, shall stand closed.
